defs.def: happening or done once every year 每年的；一年一次的；年度的

ex.s: The annual arrival of the Saint Lukas is another attempt to improve the situation.
ex.t: 圣卢卡斯每年的到来是改善这一状况的又一次尝试。

ex.s: With an impressive 2,000-seat concert hall, St David’s Hall is home to the annual Welsh Proms Cardiff.
ex.t: 圣大卫音乐厅拥有令人印象深刻的2000座音乐厅，是每年加的夫威尔士逍遥音乐节的所在地。

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

ex.s: There are three books I reread annually The first, which I take to reading every spring is Emest Hemningway’s A Moveable Feast.
ex.t: 有三本书我每年重读。第一本是海明威的《流动的盛宴》，我每年春天都会读。

ex.s: Earth Day，  4  （mark）on 22 April，is an annual event aiming to raise public awareness about environmental protection.
ex.t: 地球日，于4月22日___4___（mark），是一项旨在提高公众环保意识的年度活动。

ex.s: Some of the world’s most famous musicians recently gathered in Paris and New Orleans to celebrate the first annual International Jazz Day.
ex.t: 世界上一些最著名的音乐家最近齐聚巴黎和新奥尔良，庆祝首个年度国际爵士日。

ex.s: It is an annual series of triathlon events, and athletes compete for a chance to be World Champion.
ex.t: 这是一年一度的铁人三项系列赛，运动员争夺成为世界冠军的机会。

ex.s: In this spirit, the Laureus World Sports Awards is an annual ceremony to honour remarkable sportspeople.
ex.t: 本着这种精神，劳伦斯世界体育奖是一年一度的颁奖典礼，旨在表彰杰出的运动员。

ex.s: Last Saturday, I went to the school playground to watch the final of the 4x100-metre relay at our annual sports tournament.
ex.t: 上周六，我去学校操场观看了我们年度体育锦标赛的4x100米接力决赛。

ex.s: Each ARTS FIRST festival is a unique annual celebration of the Harvard community's artistic creativity.
ex.t: 每一届ARTS FIRST艺术节都是对哈佛社区艺术创造力的独特年度庆典。

ex.s: At least 80 inches of rain a year is normal-and in some areas there may be as much as 430 inches of rain annually.
ex.t: 每年至少80英寸降雨量是正常的——而在某些地区，年降雨量可能高达430英寸。

ex.s: This annual movement is called migration.
ex.t: 这种一年一度的迁徒被称为迁徙。

defs.def: relating to a period of one year 一年的

ex.s: Look for a card with good benefits and no annual fees.
ex.t: 寻找具有良好会员权益且无年费的银行卡。

defs.def: a book, especially one for children, that is published once a year, with the same title each time, but different contents 年刊；年报；年鉴
any plant that grows and dies within one year or season 一年生植物；一季生植物

chunks.cn: 每年的加入组织或做某事
